class.name: Authentik
class.brief_description: Global singleton for OpenID Connect (OIDC) and Authentik authentication.
class.description: [Authentik] provides a global singleton facade around a default [AuthentikClient] configured automatically from environment variables ([code]AETHERION_AUTHENTIK_*[/code], [code]AUTHENTIK_*[/code], [code]OIDC_*[/code]), [EditorSettings] ([code]network/authentik/*[/code]), or [ProjectSettings] ([code]network/authentik/*[/code]). It supports interactive browser login via OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE (RFC 7636), headless/console login via OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628), automatic token refresh, and AES-256 encrypted local session persistence. Additional isolated clients can be created with [method create_client].

method.name: cancel_login
method.description: Cancels any in-progress browser or device authorization flow on the default client.

method.name: clear_manual_override
method.description: Clears manual overrides set via [method configure] and reloads configuration from environment variables and settings.

method.name: complete_authorization_callback
method.description: Completes an interactive PKCE authorization flow using a custom URI scheme callback URL or raw query string.

method.name: configure
method.description: Manually configures the default [AuthentikClient] at runtime, overriding environment variables and settings until [method clear_manual_override] is called.

method.name: create_client
method.description: Creates and returns a standalone [AuthentikClient] instance for multi-provider or custom authentication workflows.

method.name: create_studio_client
method.description: Creates and returns a [StudioApiClient] configured with [param api_url] (or [method get_studio_api_url] when empty) that authenticates using the active Authentik session.

method.name: fetch_userinfo
method.description: Requests updated profile and group claims from the OIDC UserInfo endpoint for the active session.

method.name: get_access_token
method.description: Returns the raw OAuth 2.0 access token of the active session, or an empty string if unauthenticated.

method.name: get_authorization_header
method.description: Returns a ready-to-use HTTP [code]Authorization[/code] header value (for example [code]"Bearer <token>"[/code]), or an empty string if unauthenticated.

method.name: get_bearer_token
method.description: Returns a JWT bearer token suitable for API verification (preferring the access token when it is a JWT, or falling back to the OIDC ID token).

method.name: get_client
method.description: Returns the default [AuthentikClient] managed by this singleton.

method.name: get_client_id
method.description: Returns the currently configured OAuth 2.0 client ID.

method.name: get_issuer_url
method.description: Returns the currently configured OIDC issuer URL.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the most recent [enum AuthentikClient.AuthError] code on the default client.

method.name: get_last_error_message
method.description: Returns a human-readable description of the most recent authentication error.

method.name: get_scopes
method.description: Returns the space-delimited OAuth 2.0 scopes requested during sign-in.

method.name: get_session
method.description: Returns the active [AuthentikSession], or [code]null[/code] if not signed in.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns the current [enum AuthentikClient.Status] of the default client.

method.name: get_studio_api_url
method.description: Returns the configured Studio Server base URL (resolved from [code]AETHERION_STUDIO_API_URL[/code], [code]STUDIO_API_URL[/code], [EditorSettings], or [ProjectSettings]).

method.name: has_any_group
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the authenticated user belongs to at least one group in [param groups].

method.name: has_entitlement
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the authenticated user holds the specified Authentik application entitlement.

method.name: has_environment_override
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if environment variables are currently overriding issuer or client ID settings.

method.name: has_group
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the authenticated user is a member of [param group].

method.name: is_authenticated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a valid, non-expired [AuthentikSession] is currently active.

method.name: is_busy
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while discovery, login, token exchange, or token refresh is in progress.

method.name: is_configured
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if both an issuer URL and client ID are configured.

method.name: login_device_code
method.description: Starts an OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) flow. Emits [signal device_code_received] once the user code and verification URI are issued.

method.name: login_interactive
method.description: Starts an interactive OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE (RFC 7636) flow with a local [code]127.0.0.1[/code] loopback listener and opens the system web browser when [param open_browser] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: logout
method.description: Clears the active session and removes any persisted session file. Optionally revokes the token at the provider and opens the OIDC end-session URL.

method.name: poll
method.description: Advances pending network and loopback callback operations. Called automatically every frame when a [SceneTree] is active; call manually in custom [MainLoop] or headless scripts without frame ticks.

method.name: refresh_session
method.description: Refreshes the current session using its OAuth 2.0 refresh token.

method.name: reload_settings
method.description: Reloads provider settings from environment variables, [EditorSettings], or [ProjectSettings].

method.name: set_studio_api_url
method.description: Manually overrides the Studio Server base URL until [method clear_manual_override] is called.

signal.name: authenticated
signal.description: Emitted when sign-in succeeds and an [AuthentikSession] becomes active.

signal.name: authentication_failed
signal.description: Emitted when sign-in or token refresh fails.

signal.name: authorization_url_ready
signal.description: Emitted when the interactive PKCE browser authorization URL has been constructed.

signal.name: device_code_received
signal.description: Emitted during [method login_device_code] when the user verification code is ready to display.

signal.name: logged_out
signal.description: Emitted when the active session is signed out.

signal.name: session_refreshed
signal.description: Emitted when the active session's tokens are refreshed.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever the default client's [enum AuthentikClient.Status] changes.
